title: Renderx
description: RenderX is a upgraded version of Fabulously Optimized we added a lot of useful mods and extra items like bridges , windows , doors , lamps etc. all rights goes to mod creators and Fabulously Optimized
body:
Transform your Minecraft survival experience into something far more immersive, creative, and optimized.

This modpack is designed to enhance the core survival gameplay by introducing a wide range of decorative and functional building elements. From detailed furniture and stylish windows to custom bridges, doors, trapdoors, roofs, stairs, and modern lighting options, every addition is crafted to give players more freedom in building and design.

Beyond aesthetics, the modpack also focuses heavily on performance. With built-in optimizations and FPS-boosting enhancements, players can enjoy smoother gameplay without compromising on visual quality or features.

Whether you're building detailed homes, large-scale structures, or simply exploring a more refined survival world, this modpack delivers a balanced mix of creativity, functionality, and performance.

Key Features:

Expanded building options with furniture, windows, bridges, and more
Enhanced survival gameplay without changing the core feel
Optimized performance for better FPS and smoother experience
Perfect balance between aesthetics and efficiency
(I do NOT own any of the mods in this modpack. I only combined them into one modpack for people to play. I do NOT claim to have rights to any of these modpacks.)

Create better. Build smarter. Play smoother.
